description: This file defines the Opencart"catalog/model/tool/upload.php" class, which implements upload-related functionalities such as adding an upload record to the database and retrieving upload information by code within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Handles operations related to file uploads, including creating records in the database and retrieving upload details by code.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record in the database with a generated code, file name, and other data.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Retrieves upload information from the database based on the provided code.
